learn.b: Say Hola for hello. Use Buenos días in the morning, Buenas tardes in the afternoon and Buenas noches at night. To say goodbye, use Adiós or Hasta luego (see you later).
To say your name, use Me llamo and then your name. Me llamo Ana means My name is Ana. To ask someone, say ¿Cómo te llamas?
Ask ¿Cómo estás? to say How are you? You can answer Bien, gracias (Fine, thanks). Say por favor for please, gracias for thank you and de nada for you're welcome.

qs.q: How do you say 'good morning' in Spanish?
qs.why: Buenos días is used to greet people in the morning.

qs.q: What does 'Me llamo Ana' mean?
qs.why: Me llamo means 'my name is'.

qs.q: Which word means 'thank you'?
qs.why: Gracias is the Spanish word for thank you.

qs.q: How can you answer '¿Cómo estás?' if you feel fine?
qs.why: Bien, gracias means 'Fine, thanks'.

qs.q: 'Adiós' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: Adiós is a common way to say goodbye.

qs.q: Match each Spanish word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hello, my name is Luis'

learn.b: Count like this: uno, dos, tres, cuatro, cinco, seis, siete, ocho, nueve, diez. Use them for ages, prices and addresses.
Rojo is red, azul is blue, verde is green and amarillo is yellow. Colors usually come after the noun, like la manzana roja (the red apple).
Learn el pan (bread), el agua (water), la manzana (apple) and la leche (milk). To ask for something, say Quiero and then the thing. Quiero agua means I want water.

qs.q: What is 'cinco' in English?
qs.why: Cinco is the number five.

qs.q: Which word means 'blue'?
qs.why: Azul means blue; rojo is red and verde is green.

qs.q: What does 'la manzana' mean?
qs.why: La manzana is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I want water'?
qs.why: Quiero means 'I want', so Quiero agua is 'I want water'.

qs.q: 'Siete' means seven.
qs.why: Siete is the number seven.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn la madre (mother), el padre (father), el hermano (brother) and la hermana (sister). Words with el are masculine and words with la are feminine.
Ser has the forms soy (I am), eres (you are) and es (he or she is). Yo soy estudiante means I am a student.
Tener has the forms tengo (I have), tienes (you have) and tiene (he or she has). Tengo un hermano means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'la hermana' mean?
qs.why: La hermana means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Yo ___ estudiante. (I am a student)
qs.why: Soy is the 'I' form of ser (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: Tengo is the 'I' form of tener (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Ella ___ dos gatos. (She has two cats)
qs.why: Tiene is the 'he or she' form of tener.

qs.q: 'El padre' means 'the father'.
qs.why: El padre is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I have two sisters'

learn.b: Use el or la for 'the' with one thing and los or las for many. Un and una mean 'a'. To make most plurals, add -s: libro becomes libros.
The days are lunes, martes, miércoles, jueves, viernes, sábado and domingo. They are not written with a capital letter in Spanish.
Use ¿Dónde está...? to ask where something is. ¿Dónde está la escuela? means Where is the school? Remember la casa (house) and la escuela (school) use la.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'casa' (house)?
qs.why: Casa is feminine, so it uses la.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'libro'?
qs.why: Add -s to most words that end in a vowel: libros.

qs.q: What does 'miércoles' mean?
qs.why: Miércoles is Wednesday.

qs.q: What does '¿Dónde está la escuela?' ask?
qs.why: Dónde means 'where'.

qs.q: 'Sábado' means Sunday.
qs.why: Sábado is Saturday; Sunday is domingo.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: For -ar verbs, use -é, -aste, -ó: hablé (I spoke), hablaste (you spoke), habló (he or she spoke). For -er and -ir verbs, use -í, -iste, -ió: comí (I ate).

learn.h: Ir and ser in the past
learn.b: Ir (to go) and ser (to be) share the same past forms: fui, fuiste, fue. Context tells you which one is meant. Fui al cine means I went to the cinema.
Use ayer (yesterday), anoche (last night), la semana pasada (last week) and el año pasado (last year). They show that the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Ayer yo ___ pizza. (I ate)
qs.why: Comí is the past 'I' form of comer.

qs.q: What does 'hablaste' mean?
qs.why: The ending -aste is the past 'you' form.

qs.q: What does 'Fui al cine anoche' mean?
o: I went to the movies last night
I go to the movies every night
I will go to the movies tonight
I was at the movies last week
qs.why: Fui is 'I went' and anoche is 'last night'.

qs.q: Which word means 'yesterday'?
qs.why: Ayer means yesterday; anoche means last night.

qs.q: 'Ella comió' means 'She ate'.
qs.why: Comió is the past 'he or she' form of comer.

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I ate pizza'

learn.b: Use a la derecha (to the right), a la izquierda (to the left) and todo recto (straight ahead). La esquina is the corner.
Cerca de means near and lejos de means far from. To ask the way, say ¿Cómo llego a la estación? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn el aeropuerto (airport), el billete (ticket), la estación (station) and la habitación (room). Use reservar to say to book.

qs.q: What does 'a la izquierda' mean?
qs.why: Izquierda means left.

qs.q: What does 'todo recto' mean?
qs.why: Todo recto means straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: ¿Cómo llego a...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'la habitación' at a hotel?
qs.why: La habitación means the room.

qs.q: 'Lejos de' means 'far from'.
qs.why: Lejos means far; cerca means near.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order

learn.b: Use me gusta with one thing and me gustan with many things. Me gusta el cine means I like cinema. Me gustan los libros means I like books. Say no me gusta for I don't like.
Say creo que or pienso que to mean I think that. Say estoy de acuerdo for I agree and no estoy de acuerdo for I disagree.
Prefiero means I prefer. Porque means because, and más que means more than. Prefiero el té al café means I prefer tea to coffee.

qs.q: Which sentence means 'I like the books'?
qs.why: Books are plural, so use me gustan.

qs.q: What does 'Estoy de acuerdo' mean?
qs.why: Estoy de acuerdo means I agree.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
qs.why: Creo que + a sentence means 'I think that...'.

qs.q: What does 'Prefiero el té al café' express?
o: A preference for tea over coffee
qs.why: Prefiero means 'I prefer'.

qs.q: 'Porque' means 'because'.
qs.why: Porque (one word) introduces a reason.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I think that cinema is fun'

learn.b: Use ir a + a verb to talk about plans: voy a viajar means I am going to travel. Add words like mañana (tomorrow) or el próximo año (next year).
Reflexive verbs use me: me levanto (I get up), me ducho (I shower) and me acuesto (I go to bed). Add the time with a la una or a las siete.
The imperfect tense talks about habits in the past. Jugaba means I used to play. Use words like siempre (always) and de niño (as a child).

qs.q: Complete: Mañana ___ a viajar. (I'm going to travel)
qs.why: Voy a + verb expresses a plan for the future.

qs.q: What does 'Me levanto a las siete' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Me levanto means 'I get up'.

qs.q: Which form means 'I used to play'?
qs.why: Jugaba is the imperfect form for past habits.

qs.q: What does 'el próximo año' mean?
qs.why: Próximo means next.

qs.q: 'Me acuesto' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Me acuesto means I go to bed.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put this morning routine in a logical order

learn.b: Say Bonjour for hello or good day, and Salut for a casual hi. Use Bonsoir in the evening and Bonne nuit before bed. To say goodbye, use Au revoir.
Say Je m'appelle and your name: Je m'appelle Léa means My name is Léa. Ask Comment ça va ? to say How are you? and answer Ça va bien.
Merci means thank you and De rien means you're welcome. S'il vous plaît means please. It is the polite form you use with adults or strangers.

qs.q: How do you say 'good evening' in French?
qs.why: Bonsoir is used to greet people in the evening.

qs.q: What does 'Je m'appelle Léa' mean?
qs.why: Je m'appelle means 'my name is'.

qs.q: Which phrase means 'please' (polite)?
qs.why: S'il vous plaît is the polite way to say please.

qs.q: What does 'Comment ça va ?' ask?
qs.why: Comment ça va ? means 'How are you?'.

qs.q: 'Au revoir' means 'hello'.
qs.why: Au revoir means goodbye.

qs.q: Match each French phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hello, my name is Paul'

learn.b: Count like this: un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept, huit, neuf, dix. Use them for ages, prices and phone numbers.
Rouge is red, bleu is blue, vert is green and jaune is yellow. Colors usually come after the noun: la pomme rouge means the red apple.
Learn le pain (bread), l'eau (water), la pomme (apple) and le lait (milk). To ask politely, say Je voudrais. Je voudrais de l'eau means I would like some water.

qs.q: What is 'sept' in English?
qs.why: Sept is the number seven.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Vert means green.

qs.q: What does 'la pomme' mean?
qs.why: La pomme is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I would like some water'?
qs.why: Je voudrais means 'I would like'.

qs.q: 'Le lait' means 'milk'.
qs.why: Le lait is milk.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn la mère (mother), le père (father), le frère (brother) and la sœur (sister). Le goes with masculine words and la with feminine words.
Être has the forms je suis (I am), tu es (you are) and il est (he is). Je suis étudiant means I am a student.
Avoir has the forms j'ai (I have), tu as (you have) and il a (he has). J'ai un frère means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'la sœur' mean?
qs.why: La sœur means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Je ___ étudiant. (I am a student)
qs.why: Suis is the 'I' form of être (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: J'ai is the 'I' form of avoir (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Elle ___ deux chats. (She has two cats)
qs.why: A is the 'he or she' form of avoir.

qs.q: 'Le père' means 'the father'.
qs.why: Le père is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'My mother has two brothers'

learn.b: Use le or la for 'the' with one thing and les for many. Un and une mean 'a'. Most plurals add -s, which you do not pronounce: livre becomes livres.
The days are lundi, mardi, mercredi, jeudi, vendredi, samedi and dimanche. In French they are written with a small first letter.
Use Où est...? to ask where something is. Où est l'école ? means Where is the school? La maison (house) and l'école (school) are both feminine.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'maison' (house)?
qs.why: Maison is feminine, so it uses la.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'livre'?
qs.why: Most plurals add -s: livres.

qs.q: What does 'mercredi' mean?
qs.why: Mercredi is Wednesday.

qs.q: What does 'Où est l'école ?' ask?
qs.why: Où means 'where'.

qs.q: 'Samedi' means Sunday.
qs.why: Samedi is Saturday; Sunday is dimanche.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: Most verbs use avoir plus a past participle. J'ai mangé means I ate. Nous avons parlé means we spoke. For -er verbs, the participle ends in -é.
Some verbs of movement, like aller (to go) and arriver (to arrive), use être. Je suis allé au cinéma means I went to the cinema. A girl writes allée.
Use hier (yesterday), ce matin (this morning), la semaine dernière (last week) and l'année dernière (last year). They show the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Hier, j'___ une pizza. (I ate)
qs.why: J'ai mangé is the passé composé of manger.

qs.q: What does 'Nous avons parlé' mean?
qs.why: Nous avons parlé is the past tense: we spoke.

qs.q: Which helper verb does 'aller' use in the passé composé?
qs.why: Aller is a verb of movement and takes être.

qs.q: What does 'hier' mean?
qs.why: Hier means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Je suis allé au cinéma' means 'I went to the cinema'.
qs.why: Je suis allé is the past tense of aller: I went.

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I ate a pizza'

learn.b: Use à gauche (to the left), à droite (to the right) and tout droit (straight ahead). Au coin means at the corner.
Près de means near and loin de means far from. To ask the way, say Comment aller à la gare ? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn la gare (train station), l'aéroport (airport), le billet (ticket) and la chambre (room). Use réserver for to book.

qs.q: What does 'à gauche' mean?
qs.why: Gauche means left.

qs.q: What does 'tout droit' mean?
qs.why: Tout droit means straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: Comment aller à...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'la chambre' in a hotel?
qs.why: La chambre means the room.

qs.q: 'Près de' means 'far from'.
qs.why: Près de means near; loin de means far from.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order

learn.b: Use j'aime (I like), j'adore (I love) and je déteste (I hate). J'aime le cinéma means I like cinema. Add ne...pas for the negative: je n'aime pas.
Say je pense que or à mon avis to mean I think that or in my opinion. Say je suis d'accord for I agree and je ne suis pas d'accord for I disagree.
Je préfère means I prefer. Parce que means because, and plus...que means more than. Le film est plus long que le livre means the film is longer than the book.

qs.q: What does 'Je suis d'accord' mean?
qs.why: Je suis d'accord means I agree.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
qs.why: Je pense que + a sentence means 'I think that...'.

qs.q: What does 'parce que' mean?
qs.why: Parce que introduces a reason.

qs.q: What does 'à mon avis' mean?
qs.why: Avis means opinion, so à mon avis is 'in my opinion'.

qs.q: 'Je déteste' means 'I love'.
qs.why: Je déteste means I hate.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I think that cinema is fun'

learn.b: Use aller + a verb to talk about plans: je vais voyager means I am going to travel. Add words like demain (tomorrow) or l'année prochaine (next year).
Reflexive verbs use me: je me lève (I get up), je me douche (I shower) and je me couche (I go to bed). Add the time with à sept heures.
The imparfait talks about habits in the past. Je jouais means I used to play. Use words like toujours (always) and quand j'étais petit (when I was little).

qs.q: Complete: Demain, je ___ voyager. (I'm going to travel)
qs.why: Je vais + verb expresses a plan for the future.

qs.q: What does 'Je me lève à sept heures' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Je me lève means 'I get up'.

qs.q: Which form means 'I used to play'?
qs.why: Je jouais is the imparfait, used for past habits.

qs.q: What does 'l'année prochaine' mean?
qs.why: Prochaine means next.

qs.q: 'Je me couche' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Je me couche means I go to bed.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put this morning routine in a logical order

learn.b: Say Hallo for hello. Use Guten Morgen in the morning, Guten Tag during the day, Guten Abend in the evening and Gute Nacht before bed. To say goodbye, use Tschüss or Auf Wiedersehen.
Say Ich heiße and your name: Ich heiße Anna means My name is Anna. Ask Wie geht's? to say How are you? and answer Gut, danke.
Danke means thank you and Bitte means please or you're welcome. All German nouns start with a capital letter.

qs.q: How do you say 'good morning' in German?
qs.why: Guten Morgen is used to greet people in the morning.

qs.q: What does 'Ich heiße Anna' mean?
qs.why: Ich heiße means 'my name is'.

qs.q: Which word means 'thank you'?
qs.why: Danke is the German word for thank you.

qs.q: What does 'Wie geht's?' ask?
qs.why: Wie geht's? means 'How are you?'.

qs.q: 'Tschüss' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: Tschüss is a casual way to say goodbye.

qs.q: Match each German phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hello, my name is Max'

learn.b: Count like this: eins, zwei, drei, vier, fünf, sechs, sieben, acht, neun, zehn. Use them for ages, prices and phone numbers.
Rot is red, blau is blue, grün is green and gelb is yellow. Learn them together with the nouns, like der Apfel (the apple).
Learn das Brot (bread), das Wasser (water), der Apfel (apple) and die Milch (milk). To ask politely, say Ich möchte. Ich möchte Wasser means I would like water.

qs.q: What is 'sieben' in English?
qs.why: Sieben is the number seven.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Grün means green.

qs.q: What does 'der Apfel' mean?
qs.why: Der Apfel is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I would like water'?
qs.why: Ich möchte means 'I would like'.

qs.q: 'Die Milch' means 'milk'.
qs.why: Die Milch is milk.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn die Mutter (mother), der Vater (father), der Bruder (brother) and die Schwester (sister). Der, die and das all mean 'the'.
Sein has the forms ich bin (I am), du bist (you are) and er ist (he is). Ich bin Schüler means I am a pupil.
Haben has the forms ich habe (I have), du hast (you have) and er hat (he has). Ich habe einen Bruder means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'die Schwester' mean?
qs.why: Die Schwester means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Ich ___ Schüler. (I am a pupil)
qs.why: Bin is the 'I' form of sein (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: Habe is the 'I' form of haben (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Sie ___ zwei Katzen. (She has two cats)
qs.why: Hat is the 'he or she' form of haben.

qs.q: 'Der Vater' means 'the father'.
qs.why: Der Vater is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'My mother has two brothers'

learn.b: German has three words for 'the': der, die and das. The plural is always die. Plurals change in different ways: das Buch becomes die Bücher.
The days are Montag, Dienstag, Mittwoch, Donnerstag, Freitag, Samstag and Sonntag. They are written with a capital letter.
Use Wo ist...? to ask where something is. Wo ist die Schule? means Where is the school? Das Haus (house) uses das.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'Haus' (house)?
qs.why: Haus is neuter, so it uses das.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'Buch' (book)?
qs.why: The plural of das Buch is die Bücher.

qs.q: What does 'Mittwoch' mean?
qs.why: Mittwoch means Wednesday (literally 'mid-week').

qs.q: What does 'Wo ist die Schule?' ask?
qs.why: Wo means 'where'.

qs.q: 'Samstag' means Sunday.
qs.why: Samstag is Saturday; Sunday is Sonntag.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: Most verbs use haben plus a past participle at the end. Ich habe Pizza gegessen means I ate pizza. Wir haben gespielt means we played.
Verbs of movement and change, like gehen (to go) and fahren (to drive), use sein. Ich bin ins Kino gegangen means I went to the cinema.
Use gestern (yesterday), heute Morgen (this morning), letzte Woche (last week) and letztes Jahr (last year). They show the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Gestern ___ ich Pizza gegessen. (I ate)
qs.why: Essen uses haben: ich habe gegessen.

qs.q: What does 'Wir haben gespielt' mean?
qs.why: Wir haben gespielt is the Perfekt: we played.

qs.q: Which helper verb does 'gehen' use in the Perfekt?
qs.why: Gehen is a verb of movement and takes sein.

qs.q: What does 'gestern' mean?
qs.why: Gestern means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Ich bin ins Kino gegangen' means 'I went to the cinema'.
qs.why: Ich bin gegangen is the Perfekt of gehen: I went.

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I ate pizza'

learn.b: Use links (left), rechts (right) and geradeaus (straight ahead). An der Ecke means at the corner.
In der Nähe von means near and weit weg means far away. To ask the way, say Wie komme ich zum Bahnhof? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn der Bahnhof (station), der Flughafen (airport), die Fahrkarte (ticket) and das Zimmer (room). Use buchen for to book.

qs.q: What does 'links' mean?
qs.why: Links means left; rechts means right.

qs.q: What does 'geradeaus' mean?
qs.why: Geradeaus means straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: Wie komme ich zu...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'das Zimmer' at a hotel?
qs.why: Das Zimmer means the room.

qs.q: 'In der Nähe von' means 'far from'.
qs.why: In der Nähe von means near; weit weg means far away.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order

learn.b: Use ich mag (I like) and ich finde...gut (I think...is good). Ich mag Musik means I like music. Say ich mag nicht or ich finde...schlecht for the negative.
Say ich denke, dass... for I think that... The verb goes to the end after dass: Ich denke, dass es gut ist. Say ich bin einverstanden for I agree.
Use lieber to say you prefer something: Ich spiele lieber Fußball. Weil means because and besser als means better than. The verb also goes to the end after weil.

qs.q: What does 'Ich bin einverstanden' mean?
qs.why: Einverstanden means in agreement.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
o: Ich denke, dass es gut ist
Ich denke, dass ist es gut
Ich denke es dass gut ist
qs.why: After dass, the verb goes to the end of the clause.

qs.q: What does 'weil' mean?
qs.why: Weil introduces a reason.

qs.q: What does 'Ich spiele lieber Fußball' mean?
qs.why: Lieber shows a preference.

qs.q: 'Ich finde das schlecht' means 'I think that is bad'.
qs.why: Schlecht means bad.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I find the film very good'

learn.b: Use werden plus a verb for the future: Ich werde reisen means I will travel. You can also use the present with a time word: Morgen fahre ich nach Berlin.
Many routine verbs split in two: ich stehe um sieben auf (I get up at seven). Others are reflexive: ich ziehe mich an (I get dressed). Ich gehe ins Bett means I go to bed.
In the simple past, ich bin becomes ich war (I was). It is often used instead of the Perfekt. Time words include nächstes Jahr (next year) and immer (always).

qs.q: Complete: Morgen ___ ich nach Berlin reisen. (I will travel)
qs.why: Werden + a verb at the end forms the future.

qs.q: What does 'Ich stehe um sieben auf' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Aufstehen means to get up.

qs.q: What does 'ich war' mean?
qs.why: War is the simple past of sein.

qs.q: What does 'nächstes Jahr' mean?
qs.why: Nächstes means next.

qs.q: 'Ich gehe ins Bett' means 'I get up'.
qs.why: Ich gehe ins Bett means I go to bed.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put this morning routine in a logical order

learn.b: Say Ciao for a casual hi or bye. Use Buongiorno in the morning, Buonasera in the evening and Buonanotte before bed. To say goodbye politely, use Arrivederci.
Say Mi chiamo and your name: Mi chiamo Marco means My name is Marco. Ask Come stai? to say How are you? and answer Sto bene (I am well).
Grazie means thank you and Prego means you're welcome. Per favore means please.

qs.q: How do you say 'good evening' in Italian?
qs.why: Buonasera is used to greet people in the evening.

qs.q: What does 'Mi chiamo Marco' mean?
qs.why: Mi chiamo means 'my name is'.

qs.q: Which word means 'thank you'?
qs.why: Grazie is the Italian word for thank you.

qs.q: What does 'Come stai?' ask?
qs.why: Come stai? means 'How are you?'.

qs.q: 'Arrivederci' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: Arrivederci is a polite way to say goodbye.

qs.q: Match each Italian word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hi, my name is Luca'

learn.b: Count like this: uno, due, tre, quattro, cinque, sei, sette, otto, nove, dieci. Use them for ages, prices and phone numbers.
Rosso is red, blu is blue, verde is green and giallo is yellow. Colors usually come after the noun: la mela rossa means the red apple.
Learn il pane (bread), l'acqua (water), la mela (apple) and il latte (milk). To ask politely, say Vorrei. Vorrei acqua means I would like water.

qs.q: What is 'cinque' in English?
qs.why: Cinque is the number five.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Verde means green.

qs.q: What does 'la mela' mean?
qs.why: La mela is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I would like water'?
qs.why: Vorrei means 'I would like'.

qs.q: 'Sette' means seven.
qs.why: Sette is the number seven.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn la madre (mother), il padre (father), il fratello (brother) and la sorella (sister). Il goes with most masculine words and la with feminine words.
Essere has the forms io sono (I am), tu sei (you are) and lui è (he is). Io sono studente means I am a student.
Avere has the forms io ho (I have), tu hai (you have) and lui ha (he has). Ho un fratello means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'la sorella' mean?
qs.why: La sorella means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Io ___ studente. (I am a student)
qs.why: Sono is the 'I' form of essere (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: Ho is the 'I' form of avere (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Lei ___ due gatti. (She has two cats)
qs.why: Ha is the 'he or she' form of avere.

qs.q: 'Il padre' means 'the father'.
qs.why: Il padre is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'My mother has two brothers'

learn.b: Use il or la for 'the' with one thing, and i or le for many. Un and una mean 'a'. Plurals change the ending: libro becomes libri and casa becomes case.
The days are lunedì, martedì, mercoledì, giovedì, venerdì, sabato and domenica. They are written with a small first letter.
Use Dov'è...? to ask where something is. Dov'è la scuola? means Where is the school? La casa (house) and la scuola (school) are both feminine.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'casa' (house)?
qs.why: Casa is feminine, so it uses la.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'libro'?
qs.why: Masculine words ending in -o change to -i in the plural.

qs.q: What does 'mercoledì' mean?
qs.why: Mercoledì is Wednesday.

qs.q: What does 'Dov'è la scuola?' ask?
qs.why: Dov'è means 'where is'.

qs.q: 'Sabato' means Sunday.
qs.why: Sabato is Saturday; Sunday is domenica.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: Most verbs use avere plus a past participle. Ho mangiato means I ate. Abbiamo parlato means we spoke. For -are verbs, the participle ends in -ato.
Verbs of movement, like andare (to go) and arrivare (to arrive), use essere. Sono andato al cinema means I went to the cinema. A girl writes andata.
Use ieri (yesterday), ieri sera (last night), la settimana scorsa (last week) and l'anno scorso (last year). They show the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Ieri ___ una pizza. (I ate)
qs.why: Ho mangiato is the passato prossimo of mangiare.

qs.q: What does 'Abbiamo parlato' mean?
qs.why: Abbiamo parlato is the past tense: we spoke.

qs.q: Which helper verb does 'andare' use in the passato prossimo?
qs.why: Andare is a verb of movement and takes essere.

qs.q: What does 'ieri' mean?
qs.why: Ieri means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Sono andato al cinema' means 'I went to the cinema'.
qs.why: Sono andato is the past tense of andare: I went.

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I ate a pizza'

learn.b: Use a sinistra (to the left), a destra (to the right) and sempre dritto (straight ahead). All'angolo means at the corner.
Vicino a means near and lontano da means far from. To ask the way, say Come arrivo alla stazione? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn la stazione (station), l'aeroporto (airport), il biglietto (ticket) and la camera (room). Use prenotare for to book.

qs.q: What does 'a sinistra' mean?
qs.why: Sinistra means left.

qs.q: What does 'sempre dritto' mean?
qs.why: Sempre dritto means straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: Come arrivo a...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'la camera' at a hotel?
qs.why: La camera means the room.

qs.q: 'Vicino a' means 'far from'.
qs.why: Vicino a means near; lontano da means far from.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order

learn.b: Use mi piace with one thing and mi piacciono with many things. Mi piace il cinema means I like cinema. Mi piacciono i libri means I like books. Say non mi piace for I don't like.
Say penso che or secondo me to mean I think that or in my opinion. Say sono d'accordo for I agree and non sono d'accordo for I disagree.
Preferisco means I prefer. Più...di means more than. After penso che, Italian uses the subjunctive, like sia (is): Penso che sia bello.

qs.q: Which sentence means 'I like the books'?
qs.why: Books are plural, so use mi piacciono.

qs.q: What does 'Sono d'accordo' mean?
qs.why: Sono d'accordo means I agree.

qs.q: What does 'secondo me' mean?
qs.why: Secondo me means 'in my opinion'.

qs.q: What does 'Preferisco il tè al caffè' express?
o: A preference for tea over coffee
qs.why: Preferisco means 'I prefer'.

qs.q: 'Non sono d'accordo' means 'I disagree'.
qs.why: Non turns 'I agree' into 'I do not agree'.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I think cinema is fun'

learn.b: Use andare a + a verb to talk about plans: vado a viaggiare means I am going to travel. Add words like domani (tomorrow) or l'anno prossimo (next year).
Reflexive verbs use mi: mi alzo (I get up), mi lavo (I wash) and mi sveglio (I wake up). Vado a letto means I go to bed.
The imperfetto talks about habits in the past. Giocavo means I used to play. Use words like sempre (always) and da piccolo (as a child).

qs.q: Complete: Domani ___ a viaggiare. (I'm going to travel)
qs.why: Vado a + verb expresses a plan for the future.

qs.q: What does 'Mi alzo alle sette' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Mi alzo means 'I get up'.

qs.q: Which form means 'I used to play'?
qs.why: Giocavo is the imperfetto, used for past habits.

qs.q: What does 'l'anno prossimo' mean?
qs.why: Prossimo means next.

qs.q: 'Vado a letto' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Vado a letto means I go to bed.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put this morning routine in a logical order

learn.b: Say Olá for hello. Use Bom dia in the morning, Boa tarde in the afternoon and Boa noite in the evening or at night. To say goodbye, use Tchau.
Say Meu nome é and your name: Meu nome é Ana means My name is Ana. Ask Tudo bem? to say How are you? or Is everything good? and answer Tudo bem.
Men say obrigado and women say obrigada for thank you. De nada means you're welcome. Por favor means please.

qs.q: How do you say 'good morning' in Portuguese?
qs.why: Bom dia is used to greet people in the morning.

qs.q: What does 'Meu nome é Ana' mean?
qs.why: Meu nome é means 'my name is'.

qs.q: A woman wants to say 'thank you'. Which word does she use?
qs.why: Women say obrigada and men say obrigado.

qs.q: What does 'Tudo bem?' ask?
o: How are you? / Is everything good?
qs.why: Tudo bem? is a common way to ask how someone is.

qs.q: 'Tchau' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: Tchau is a common way to say goodbye.

qs.q: Match each Portuguese word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hello, my name is Pedro'

learn.b: Count like this: um, dois, três, quatro, cinco, seis, sete, oito, nove, dez. Use them for ages, prices and phone numbers.
Vermelho is red, azul is blue, verde is green and amarelo is yellow. Colors usually come after the noun: a maçã vermelha means the red apple.
Learn o pão (bread), a água (water), a maçã (apple) and o leite (milk). To ask for something, say Eu quero and then the thing. Eu quero água means I want water.

qs.q: What is 'cinco' in English?
qs.why: Cinco is the number five.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Verde means green.

qs.q: What does 'a maçã' mean?
qs.why: A maçã is the apple.

qs.q: How do you say 'I want water'?
qs.why: Eu quero means 'I want'.

qs.q: 'Sete' means seven.
qs.why: Sete is the number seven.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn a mãe (mother), o pai (father), o irmão (brother) and a irmã (sister). O goes with masculine words and a with feminine words.
Ser has the forms eu sou (I am) and você é (you are) or ele é (he is). Eu sou estudante means I am a student.
Ter has the forms eu tenho (I have) and você tem (you have) or ela tem (she has). Eu tenho um irmão means I have a brother.

qs.q: What does 'a irmã' mean?
qs.why: A irmã means the sister.

qs.q: Complete: Eu ___ estudante. (I am a student)
qs.why: Sou is the 'I' form of ser (to be).

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
qs.why: Tenho is the 'I' form of ter (to have).

qs.q: Complete: Ela ___ dois gatos. (She has two cats)
qs.why: Tem is the 'he or she' form of ter.

qs.q: 'O pai' means 'the father'.
qs.why: O pai is the father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I have two brothers'

learn.b: Use o or a for 'the' with one thing and os or as for many. Um and uma mean 'a'. Most plurals add -s: livro becomes livros. Words ending in -l change, like animal to animais.
Monday to Friday end in -feira: segunda-feira, terça-feira, quarta-feira, quinta-feira and sexta-feira. Then come sábado and domingo.
Use Onde fica...? to ask where a place is. Onde fica a escola? means Where is the school? A casa (house) and a escola (school) are both feminine.

qs.q: Which article goes with 'casa' (house)?
qs.why: Casa is feminine, so it uses a.

qs.q: What is the plural of 'livro'?
qs.why: Add -s to words that end in a vowel: livros.

qs.q: What does 'quarta-feira' mean?
qs.why: Quarta-feira is Wednesday, the fourth day in the Portuguese count.

qs.q: What does 'Onde fica a escola?' ask?
qs.why: Onde means 'where'.

qs.q: 'Sábado' means Sunday.
qs.why: Sábado is Saturday; Sunday is domingo.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: For -ar verbs, use -ei, -ou, -amos: falei (I spoke), falou (he or she spoke). For -er verbs, use -i, -eu, -emos: comi (I ate), comeu (he or she ate).

learn.h: Ir and ser in the past
learn.b: Ir (to go) and ser (to be) share the same past forms: fui, foi, fomos. Context tells you which one is meant. Fui ao cinema means I went to the cinema.
Use ontem (yesterday), ontem à noite (last night), semana passada (last week) and ano passado (last year). They show that the action is finished.

qs.q: Complete: Ontem eu ___ pizza. (I ate)
qs.why: Comi is the past 'I' form of comer.

qs.q: What does 'Falei com ela' mean?
qs.why: Falei is the past 'I' form of falar.

qs.q: What does 'Fui ao cinema ontem' mean?
o: I went to the cinema yesterday
I go to the cinema every day
I will go to the cinema tomorrow
qs.why: Fui is 'I went' and ontem is 'yesterday'.

qs.q: Which word means 'yesterday'?
qs.why: Ontem means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Ele comeu' means 'He ate'.
qs.why: Comeu is the past 'he or she' form of comer.

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I ate pizza'

learn.b: Use à esquerda (to the left), à direita (to the right) and siga em frente (go straight ahead). Na esquina means on the corner.
Perto de means near and longe de means far from. To ask the way, say Como chego à estação? (How do I get to the station?).
Learn o aeroporto (airport), o ônibus (bus), a estação (station) and o quarto (room). Use reservar for to book.

qs.q: What does 'à esquerda' mean?
qs.why: Esquerda means left.

qs.q: What does 'siga em frente' mean?
qs.why: Siga em frente means go straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
qs.why: Como chego a...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'o quarto' at a hotel?
qs.why: O quarto means the room.

qs.q: 'Perto de' means 'far from'.
qs.why: Perto de means near; longe de means far from.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order

learn.b: Use eu gosto de (I like) and eu adoro (I love). Eu gosto de música means I like music. Say eu não gosto de for I don't like.
Say eu acho que to mean I think that. Say eu concordo for I agree and eu não concordo for I disagree.
Eu prefiro means I prefer. Porque means because, and mais...do que means more than. O filme é mais longo do que o livro means the film is longer than the book.

qs.q: What does 'Eu gosto de livros' mean?
qs.why: Eu gosto de means 'I like'.

qs.q: What does 'Eu concordo' mean?
qs.why: Concordo means I agree.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
qs.why: Eu acho que + a sentence means 'I think that...'.

qs.q: What does 'mais ... do que' mean?
qs.why: Mais do que is used to compare: more than.

qs.q: 'Não concordo' means 'I disagree'.
qs.why: Não turns 'I agree' into 'I do not agree'.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'I think cinema is fun'

learn.b: Use ir + a verb to talk about plans: eu vou viajar means I am going to travel. Add words like amanhã (tomorrow) or ano que vem (next year).
Reflexive verbs use me: eu me levanto (I get up). Other useful phrases are tomar banho (to shower), tomar café (to have breakfast or coffee) and ir dormir (to go to sleep).
The imperfect tense talks about habits in the past. Eu jogava means I used to play. Use words like sempre (always) and quando eu era criança (when I was a child).

qs.q: Complete: Amanhã eu ___ viajar. (I'm going to travel)
qs.why: Vou + verb expresses a plan for the future.

qs.q: What does 'Eu me levanto às sete' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Eu me levanto means 'I get up'.

qs.q: Which form means 'I used to play'?
qs.why: Jogava is the imperfect, used for past habits.

qs.q: What does 'ano que vem' mean?
qs.why: Que vem means 'that is coming', so ano que vem is next year.

qs.q: 'Eu vou dormir' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Eu vou dormir means I'm going to sleep.

qs.q: Match each phrase to its meaning
Put this morning routine in a logical order

learn.b: Say Привет (Privet) to a friend and Здравствуйте (Zdravstvuyte) to be polite. Use Доброе утро (Dobroye utro) in the morning and Добрый вечер (Dobry vecher) in the evening. To say goodbye, use До свидания (Do svidaniya).
Say Меня зовут (Menya zovut) and your name: Меня зовут Анна means My name is Anna. Ask Как дела? (Kak dela?) to say How are you?
Спасибо (Spasibo) means thank you. Пожалуйста (Pozhaluysta) means please and also you're welcome.

qs.q: How do you say 'good morning' in Russian?
qs.why: Доброе утро is used to greet people in the morning.

qs.q: What does 'Меня зовут Анна (Menya zovut Anna)' mean?
qs.why: Меня зовут means 'my name is' (literally 'they call me').

qs.q: Which word means 'thank you'?
qs.why: Спасибо is the Russian word for thank you.

qs.q: What does 'Как дела? (Kak dela?)' ask?
qs.why: Как дела? means 'How are you?'.

qs.q: 'До свидания (Do svidaniya)' means 'goodbye'.
qs.why: До свидания is the standard way to say goodbye.

qs.q: Match each Russian word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Hi, my name is Ivan'

learn.b: Count like this: один (odin), два (dva), три (tri), четыре (chetyre), пять (pyat), шесть (shest), семь (sem), восемь (vosem), девять (devyat), десять (desyat).
Красный (krasny) is red, синий (siniy) is blue, зелёный (zelyony) is green and жёлтый (zhyolty) is yellow. Colors change their ending to match the noun.
Learn хлеб (khleb) bread, вода (voda) water, яблоко (yabloko) apple and молоко (moloko) milk. Say Я хочу (Ya khochu) for I want. Я хочу воду means I want water.

qs.q: What is 'пять (pyat)' in English?
qs.why: Пять is the number five.

qs.q: Which word means 'green'?
qs.why: Зелёный means green.

qs.q: What does 'яблоко (yabloko)' mean?
qs.why: Яблоко is an apple.

qs.q: What does 'Я хочу воду (Ya khochu vodu)' mean?
qs.why: Я хочу means 'I want' and вода is water.

qs.q: 'молоко (moloko)' means 'milk'.
qs.why: Молоко is milk.

qs.q: Match each number to its meaning
Put these numbers in order from smallest to largest

learn.b: Learn мама (mama) mom, папа (papa) dad, брат (brat) brother and сестра (sestra) sister. Also бабушка (babushka) is grandmother and дедушка (dedushka) is grandfather.
Russian leaves out am, is and are in the present tense. Say Я студент (Ya student) for I am a student. Do not add a word for 'am'.
Use У меня есть (U menya yest) for I have. У меня есть брат means I have a brother. To ask a friend, say У тебя есть сестра? (U tebya yest sestra?).

qs.q: What does 'сестра (sestra)' mean?
qs.why: Сестра means sister.

qs.q: How do you say 'I am a student'?
qs.why: Russian has no word for 'am' in the present tense.

qs.q: How do you say 'I have a brother'?
o: У меня есть брат (U menya yest brat)
qs.why: У меня есть + noun is the way to say 'I have'.

qs.q: What does 'У тебя есть сестра? (U tebya yest sestra?)' ask?
qs.why: У тебя есть...? means 'Do you have...?'.

qs.q: 'папа (papa)' means 'father'.
qs.why: Папа is dad or father.

qs.q: Match each family word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yes, I have a brother'

learn.b: Russian nouns are masculine, feminine or neuter. Most masculine nouns end in a consonant, like стол (stol) table. Feminine nouns often end in -а or -я, like книга (kniga) book. Neuter nouns end in -о or -е, like окно (okno) window.

learn.h: My and days of the week
learn.b: My changes with gender: мой стол (moy stol), моя книга (moya kniga), моё окно (moyo okno). The days are понедельник (ponedelnik), вторник (vtornik), среда (sreda), четверг (chetverg), пятница (pyatnitsa), суббота (subbota) and воскресенье (voskresenye).
Use Где...? (Gde...?) to ask where something is. Где школа? (Gde shkola?) means Where is the school?

qs.q: What is the gender of 'книга (kniga)'?
qs.why: Nouns ending in -а are usually feminine.

qs.q: What does 'среда (sreda)' mean as a day?
qs.why: Среда is Wednesday.

qs.q: What does 'Где школа? (Gde shkola?)' ask?
qs.why: Где means 'where'.

qs.q: How do you say 'my book'?
qs.why: Книга is feminine, so it takes моя.

qs.q: 'суббота (subbota)' means Sunday.
qs.why: Суббота is Saturday; Sunday is воскресенье.

qs.q: Match each day to its meaning
Put these days in order, starting from Monday

learn.b: Russian past verbs change by gender, not by person. Add -л (-l) for masculine, -ла (-la) for feminine and -ли (-li) for plural. A boy says я читал (ya chital) and a girl says я читала (ya chitala).
For we, you (plural) and they, use -ли: мы работали (my rabotali) means we worked. For the past of to be, use был (byl), была (byla), было (bylo) and были (byli).
Use вчера (vchera) for yesterday, сегодня (segodnya) for today, завтра (zavtra) for tomorrow and на прошлой неделе (na proshloy nedele) for last week.

qs.q: A girl says: Вчера я ___ книгу. (I read)
qs.why: A girl uses the feminine past ending -ла.

qs.q: What does 'Мы работали (My rabotali)' mean?
qs.why: The ending -ли is the plural past, and мы means we.

qs.q: Which ending shows a masculine past verb?
qs.why: Masculine past verbs end in -л.

qs.q: What does 'вчера (vchera)' mean?
qs.why: Вчера means yesterday.

qs.q: 'Он написал письмо (On napisal pismo)' means 'He wrote a letter'.
qs.why: Написал is the masculine past of написать (to write).

qs.q: Match each time word to its meaning
Put the words in order: 'Yesterday I read a book'

learn.b: Use налево (nalevo) for to the left, направо (napravo) for to the right and прямо (pryamo) for straight ahead.
Рядом (ryadom) means nearby and далеко (daleko) means far. To ask the way, say Как пройти на вокзал? (Kak proyti na vokzal?), meaning How do I get to the station?
Learn вокзал (vokzal) station, аэропорт (aeroport) airport, билет (bilet) ticket and гостиница (gostinitsa) hotel.

qs.q: What does 'налево (nalevo)' mean?
qs.why: Налево means to the left.

qs.q: What does 'прямо (pryamo)' mean?
qs.why: Прямо means straight ahead.

qs.q: How do you ask 'How do I get to the station?'
o: Как пройти на вокзал? (Kak proyti na vokzal?)
qs.why: Как пройти на...? is the usual way to ask for directions.

qs.q: What is 'гостиница (gostinitsa)'?
qs.why: Гостиница means hotel.

qs.q: 'далеко (daleko)' means 'near'.
qs.why: Далеко means far; near is рядом.

qs.q: Match each word to its meaning
Put these travel steps in a logical order
items: Я еду в аэропорт (Ya yedu v aeroport)
Я сажусь в самолёт (Ya sazhus v samolyot)
Я приезжаю в гостиницу (Ya priezzhayu v gostinitsu)

learn.b: Use Мне нравится (Mne nravitsya) to say I like. Мне нравится музыка means I like music. For many things, say Мне нравятся (Mne nravyatsya). Say Мне не нравится for I don't like.
Say Я думаю, что (Ya dumayu, chto) for I think that. A man says Я согласен (Ya soglasen) for I agree and a woman says Я согласна (Ya soglasna).
Я предпочитаю (Ya predpochitayu) means I prefer. Потому что (potomu chto) means because. Use it to give a reason: Я люблю кино, потому что оно интересное.

qs.q: What does 'Мне нравится музыка (Mne nravitsya muzyka)' mean?
qs.why: Мне нравится means 'I like'.

qs.q: What does 'Я согласен (Ya soglasen)' mean?
qs.why: Согласен means in agreement.

qs.q: What does 'потому что (potomu chto)' mean?
qs.why: Потому что introduces a reason.

qs.q: How do you say 'I think that it is good'?
o: Я думаю хорошо что (Ya dumayu khorosho chto)
Я хорошо думаю это (Ya khorosho dumayu eto)
Думаю я что хорошо (Dumayu ya chto khorosho)
Я думаю, что это хорошо (Ya dumayu, chto eto khorosho)
qs.why: Я думаю, что + a sentence means 'I think that...'.

learn.b: Use буду (budu) plus an infinitive for the future. Завтра я буду работать (Zavtra ya budu rabotat) means Tomorrow I will work. Other forms are будешь, будет, будем.
Many routine verbs are reflexive and end in -ся or -сь: я умываюсь (ya umyvayus) I wash up. Others are я встаю (ya vstayu) I get up and я ложусь спать (ya lozhus spat) I go to bed.
Use каждый день (kazhdy den) for every day, всегда (vsegda) for always and в следующем году (v sleduyushchem godu) for next year.

qs.q: Complete: Завтра я ___ работать. (I will work)
qs.why: Буду + infinitive forms the future.

qs.q: What does 'Я встаю в семь часов (Ya vstayu v sem chasov)' mean?
o: I go to bed at seven
qs.why: Я встаю means 'I get up'.

qs.q: What does 'каждый день (kazhdy den)' mean?
qs.why: Каждый means every.

qs.q: What does 'в следующем году (v sleduyushchem godu)' mean?
qs.why: Следующем means next.

qs.q: 'Я ложусь спать (Ya lozhus spat)' means 'I wake up'.
qs.why: Я ложусь спать means I go to bed.
